{{Otheruses|Typhoon}}
'''Typhoon''' was a pair of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttles]] that, along with shuttle groups [[Thunder (shuttle group)|''Thunder'']] and [[Lightning (shuttle group)|''Lightning'']], took part in the first phrase of [[Operation Grain Snatch]]. Their role was to capture the [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] escorts of Overlord [[Ghorin]]'s [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[Halifax]]'', which contained [[Grain/Legends|grain]] for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] disabled all the Y-wings and the shuttles captured the Y-wings so that they could be used to discredit Ghorin.
